viewing_check: Weigh it (grams settle the max, use the table). Read the inside stamp with a loupe: 14ct / 585 / 14K plus maker. If unmarked, ask for an acid test or skip. Check width (expect about 6 mm), size, and thin or cracked spots at the back of the shank.
